subject: POC plan and model shortlist for BosonTech trial
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@bosontech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery — BosonTech trial next steps

Hi Laura — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposal for the POC scope so we can move to a SOW: 

Call highlights (what I heard):
- Primary goal: reduce agent-assisted resolution time for billing & subscription issues by 40% during the trial window.
- Volume: ~8k monthly support interactions across EN/ES/PT (10% Spanish, 4% Portuguese).
- Data access: we will use sanitized transcripts and a small anonymized test set you provide.
- Security: BosonTech requires SOC2 evidence and retention controls; Marcus will lead the technical checklist.

Proposed POC objectives (3 weeks):
1) Functional — achieve >= 82% intent-match accuracy on the provided evaluation set (English + Spanish).
2) Performance — P95 token latency <= 350ms on typical 256-token responses for the primary model in our dedicated trial endpoint.
3) Cost target — average per-response cost < $0.06 (we’ll tune batching/quantization).

Model shortlist for the trial (recommended stack):
- Primary candidate: LLaMA-2 13B (Q8 quantized) — balanced latency/quality, good multilingual base after instruction-tuning.
- Conversational fallback: Mistral-Instruct-7B — faster for short-turn chat and cheaper for high-volume fallbacks.
- Safety/edge-case fallback: Mosaic-7B-instruct (conservative generation profile) for longer, sensitive threads.

Multilingual notes: we’ll run bilingual evaluations and include Spanish prompt templates; full Portuguese support will be scoped to the highest-volume flows first.

Next steps I propose (please confirm):
- You: share the sanitized eval set + SOC2 questionnaire (Marcus will send the checklist by EOD).
- BosonTech: confirm 3-week trial window start (we suggested Feb 5 as earliest).
- Redwood: Marcus sets up a dedicated trial endpoint with the LLaMA-2 13B (Q8) image and Mistral fallback; I’ll draft a mutual action plan.

Attachments referenced: placeholder for your eval samples file and SOC2 form.

If that looks right, I’ll send a short MRP (mutual rolling plan) with owners and milestones by end of day.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@bosontech.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery — BosonTech trial next steps

Adding a few technical clarifications so the POC can be provisioned without delays: 

Operational checklist: 
- Endpoint config: 2 replica workers, request autoscale disabled for trial (predictable perf), burst queue cap 200 rps.
- KV/prefix caching: enable prefix cache for repeated common prompts (saves tokens).
- Tokenization and truncation policy: clamp to 1024 input tokens, include user/prompt metadata in 1 token overhead.
- Logging & telemetry: token-level cost, per-request latency, and a small sample of generations; these are available in the console and via webhook.

Evaluation rubric (suggested):
- Intent accuracy (primary): weighted micro-F1 across support intents (0.6).
- Response helpfulness (rater score 1-5): (0.3).
- Hallucination/incorrect info rate: target < 6% (0.1).
- Latency & cost are pass/fail gates.

Owner assignments (as I see it):
- Redwood: Marcus Lin (trial infra & telemetry), Olga Petrov (commercial lead), Aditya Rao (customer success & onboarding).
- BosonTech: Laura Chen (product lead), Javier Morales (SRE/contact for data transfer).

Data handling: we can provision a secure S3 ingest with per-object lifecycle; any PII will be redacted on ingest — we need the sanitized files to confirm.

If we agree, I’ll spin up a preview endpoint and share access + a short test script (curl + sample payloads) within 48 hours of receiving the eval set.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin | Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@bosontech.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Bcc: Javier Morales <j.morales@bosontech.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 17:20:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Discovery — BosonTech trial next steps

Thanks Olga and Marcus — that aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Timing: Feb 5 start works for us. We want a 3-week active evaluation + 1-week wrap-up (reports & knowledge transfer).
2) Evaluation set: attached is bosontech-eval-samples.csv (3k rows; mixed EN/ES). The Spanish examples are flagged in a column. We will send an anonymized customer support transcript sample separately.
3) Security: attached is our SOC2 questionnaire (soc2-questionnaire.pdf). We expect answers within 3 business days so procurement can move to legal.
4) Success criteria: we’ll adopt the rubric you proposed but would like to add an SLA-like pass/fail for degraded fallback usage: fallback invocation should be < 15% of total requests after tuning.

Open question: Can Redwood provide both model variants on the same endpoint with automatic routing (primary -> fallback) or do we need two endpoints? We prefer a single endpoint with routing logic.

Thanks — I’ve CC’d Javier for data transfer and engineering onboarding. We’ll confirm the signing contact for the SOW after the SOC2 questionnaire review.

—Laura
Laura Chen
Head of Product, BosonTech
laura.chen@bosontech.com
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@bosontech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jan 2028 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery — BosonTech trial next steps

Great — thanks Laura. Quick confirmations and agreed next steps: 

Agreed:
- Start date: Feb 5 (3-week active window + 1-week wrap).
- Success metrics: we’ll use the combined rubric (intent accuracy / helpfulness / hallucination) and the added fallback gate (< 15% fallback after tuning).
- Single endpoint: yes — Redwood can host a single trial endpoint with routing policies (primary LLaMA-2 13B Q8; automatic failover to Mistral-Instruct-7B and a conservative Mosaic-7B variant for long responses). Marcus will enable routing rules and TTLs.

Owners & immediate actions: 
- Laura: Share sanitized transcripts and confirm S3 access for ingest (by Jan 20).
- Javier: point-of-contact for engineer onboarding.
- Olga: I’ll circulate an MRP (mutual rolling plan) with milestones and a draft SOW by Jan 18.
- Marcus: SOC2 checklist responses and trial endpoint preview script by Jan 17.
- Aditya Rao: I'll loop you in on onboarding + success checklist; you’ll own the final acceptance call.

Attachments we expect from BosonTech: bosontech-eval-samples.csv, soc2-questionnaire.pdf. Please send the anonymized transcript as discussed.

Milestones (high level):
- Jan 17: trial endpoint preview + SOC2 responses (Redwood).
- Jan 20: sanitized transcript & final eval set (BosonTech).
- Feb 5: trial begins.
- Feb 26: end of active evaluation; Feb 29: wrap-up and acceptance call.

I’ll publish the MRP and HubSpot deal update after I draft the SOW. Thanks everyone — excited to get started.

Olga
Olga Petrov | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
